checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'audience-segmentation'.

checks.description: Each segment has name, size, definition, and why.
checks.rule: Every segment object includes name, size, definition, and why, matching the segments[] shape in handoff-contract.md.
Each size is a figure traceable to data, the context planning estimate marked as an estimate, or flagged as resolved from live data at send time; no size is invented.

checks.description: Where live data is needed, the skill flags it.
checks.rule: Sizes that cannot be confirmed from context are flagged as resolving from live data at send time and ride forward as open items.

checks.description: The segment set is small and workable.
checks.rule: The plan produces a small set, roughly three to five named segments, each defined and tied to the angle, not a long unusable list.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no U+0640 tatweel character appear in any file in this skill.

checks.description: Segments are framed empowering, not deficit-framed.
checks.rule: A non-payer or lapsed contact is framed as ready to grow, never as a failure to be fixed, per context/brand-voice.md.
